claim: The maximum air temperature in Rome on 2026-08-31 (UTC day) will be above 34.8°C.
resolution_criterion: YES if the value at JSON pointer /daily/temperature_2m_max/0 in the Open-Meteo response for latitude 41.9, longitude 12.5, start_date=2026-08-31, end_date=2026-08-31, timezone=UTC is strictly greater than 34.8. NO otherwise. The threshold was set to the forecast value published for 2026-08-31 at the time of writing, so the honest probability is close to a half. This is a canary: it is unscored and exists to exercise the pipeline daily.
